title: Sending controls
intro: Emergency pause and controlled resume for each communication context. Pausing one context never affects the other.
description.EDARA: Onboarding and operator communication sent with the managed Edara identity.
description.COMPANY: White-label communication sent with each Company's verified sender identity.
activeDescription: Messages in this context are dispatched normally.
pausedDescription: Queued messages are held and delivered once sending resumes. None are lost.
pauseDescription: Queued messages are held, not failed, and delivered once you resume. Record why you are pausing.
resumeDescription: Held messages resume delivery on the next worker pass.
unavailable.title: Sending status unavailable
unavailable.description: The current status could not be loaded. Retry shortly.
result.refused: The action was refused. Review current permissions.
result.stale: The state changed. Reconcile before continuing.
result.contract: The response could not be verified. Actions are unavailable.
result.uncertain: The outcome could not be confirmed. Reconcile before continuing.
